```typescript

import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const example = new tencentcloud.igtm.Monitor("example", {
    monitorName: "tf-example",
    checkProtocol: "PING",
    checkInterval: 60,
    timeout: 5,
    failTimes: 1,
    failRate: 50,
    detectorStyle: "INTERNAL",

        30,

        34,

    path: "/",

    enableRedirect: "DISABLED",

    packetLossRate: 90,
    continuePeriod: 1,
});
```

## Import



IGTM monitor can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Igtm/monitor:Monitor example 12355
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
